content: Slice audited: cli-core (packages/cli-core/cliapp, packages/cli-core/cliutil, scenarios/prompt-manager/cli bootstrap). Top finding: structured API recovery metadata is parsed and tested in cli-core but flattened in user-facing CLI errors. Evidence: packages/cli-core/cliutil/httpclient.go defines APIError fields and FormatConcise, returns ParseAPIError for HTTP >=400; packages/cli-core/cliutil/apiclient_test.go tests structured parse/format; scenarios/prompt-manager/cli/main.go prints app.Run errors with raw %v. Measured fixture: prompt-manager status against a local HTTP 400 JSON body with code, recovery_hint, and manual_steps exited 1 and printed only Last error: api error (400): fixture failure. Verification: go test ./cliutil ./cliapp in packages/cli-core passed; go test ./... in scenarios/prompt-manager/cli passed. Grades: architecture B, security B, test coverage B, documentation B-, cross-platform C+, signal C, instrumentation C.

Slice audited: cli-scenario-lifecycle (prompt-manager CLI team lifecycle commands, CLI parity map, heartbeat API handlers/models/executor/run registry/team execution store). Top finding: heartbeat lifecycle has API-level global active-run inspection and stop controls, but no first-class prompt-manager CLI command exposes them. Evidence: scenarios/prompt-manager/api/main.go registers GET /heartbeats/running and POST /heartbeats/running/{teamId}/{agentId}/stop; heartbeat handlers return RunningAgentsResponse and StopAgentResponse; scenarios/prompt-manager/cli/teams/teams.go dispatch/help covers heartbeat-list/heartbeat/heartbeat-enable/heartbeat-disable/heartbeat-trigger/heartbeat-logs/queue-clear but no running/stop-running command; cli/parity/coverage.json marks both active-run routes audit-pending. Measured checks: go test ./parity ./teams in scenarios/prompt-manager/cli passed; targeted go test ./heartbeat -run 'Test(ListRunning|StopRun|ClearTeamQueueRunning|Recover|Enqueue_ExecuteFailure|Parity)' -count=1 passed; go test ./parity -run TestParityProgressMetric -count=1 -v reported 123 covered, 5 intentionally-absent, 53 audit-pending. Grades: architecture B, security B, test coverage B+, documentation B-, cross-platform B, signal C+, instrumentation C+.
